units.source_en: I break.

paragraphs.source_en: Sitting in a void. Staring at my hands. The hands that could not save my wife, my child. She was right. I wasn’t strong enough to bear the truth of Eo’s second sacrifice. Eo could have lived. Eo could have given us the child we always wanted. That future wasn’t worth her silence. I wasn’t worth it …

units.source_en: Sitting in a void.
Staring at my hands.
The hands that could not save my wife, my child.
She was right.
I wasn’t strong enough to bear the truth of Eo’s second sacrifice.
Eo could have lived.
Eo could have given us the child we always wanted.
That future wasn’t worth her silence.
I wasn’t worth it …

paragraphs.source_en: I feel something deep in my chest, a hollow raw ache. Like blackness has opened in the pit of my soul even as my body tightens and coils around grief. I weigh a million pounds. Shoulders slump. Chest compressed. My fingers clutch together. Funny to think these hands have been with me this whole time. They helped pull her ankles. They buried her in the soil. But they didn’t just bury her, did they?

units.source_en: I feel something deep in my chest, a hollow raw ache.
Like blackness has opened in the pit of my soul even as my body tightens and coils around grief.
I weigh a million pounds.
Shoulders slump.
Chest compressed.
My fingers clutch together.
Funny to think these hands have been with me this whole time.
They helped pull her ankles.
They buried her in the soil.
But they didn’t just bury her, did they?

ja.t: だけではなかった。そうだろう？

paragraphs.source_en: No. They buried another life. One unborn. Our child, dead before it lived. And I never even knew. I failed them both. The amplified video replays again.

units.source_en: No.

paragraphs.source_en: “I am with child,” she tells Dio on the scaffold. “I am with child.”

units.source_en: “I am with child,” she tells Dio on the scaffold.
“I am with child.”

paragraphs.source_en: I replay it a dozen times, feeling myself shrink into a corridor of grief.

units.source_en: I replay it a dozen times, feeling myself shrink into a corridor of grief.

paragraphs.source_en: The Golds didn’t just kill her. They killed what I’ve always wanted to be—a husband and a father. If only I had stopped her. If only I had not pouted like a child when we lost the Laurel, she wouldn’t have thought to take me to the garden. If only I had the strength to pretend losing the Laurel didn’t bother me.

units.source_en: The Golds didn’t just kill her.
They killed what I’ve always wanted to be—a husband and a father.

paragraphs.source_en: All the family I could have had. A wife. Sons. Daughters. Grandchildren. They’ve been slaughtered before they ever were. Eo will never hold our daughter. She will never kiss our son to sleep and smile over at me as his little hands clutch my finger. I’m all that’s left of that family that could have been. A dark shadow of the man I was meant to be.

units.source_en: All the family I could have had.
A wife.
Sons.
Daughters.
Grandchildren.
They’ve been slaughtered before they ever were.
Eo will never hold our daughter.
She will never kiss our son to sleep and smile over at me as his little hands clutch my finger.
I’m all that’s left of that family that could have been.
A dark shadow of the man I was meant to be.

paragraphs.source_en: The rage rises. We had a chance, and it is gone. Everything I wanted is gone, because of me and because of them. Their laws. Their injustice. Their cruelty. They made a woman choose death for her and her unborn child over a life of slavery. All that for power. All that so they can keep their perfect little world.
